# PBHS JROTC - Tornado Battalion

> Official web presence for the Pompano Beach High School Army JROTC "Tornado Battalion" - cadet information, leadership roster, battalion teams, announcements, and documents. Most content is public; account creation and admin tools are for enrolled cadets and staff only.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://pbhsjrotc.com/): Battalion overview and highlights
- [About](https://pbhsjrotc.com/about): Program background and history
- [Cadet Info](https://pbhsjrotc.com/cadet-info): Cadet creed, rank structure, and general information
- [Leadership](https://pbhsjrotc.com/leadership): Battalion command staff roster
- [Teams](https://pbhsjrotc.com/teams): Battalion extracurricular teams (Drill, Raiders, Color Guard, etc.)
- [Announcements](https://pbhsjrotc.com/announcements): Battalion-wide announcements and events
- [Documents & Regulations](https://pbhsjrotc.com/documents): Published reference documents
- [Photo Gallery](https://pbhsjrotc.com/photos): Links to event photo albums

## Notes

- Pages under /admin require an authenticated cadet or staff account and are not meant for public indexing (see /robots.txt).
- This site is independently built and is not an official Broward County Public Schools or U.S. Army JROTC domain.
